title: Anna's Town
text:
Anna lives in a small town. There is a big park near her house. In the park there is a lake and many trees. Anna likes to walk there with her dog.

Next to the park there is a library. Anna goes to the library every Monday. She reads books and does her homework there. The bakery is across the street, and it sells good bread.

questions.text: How often does Anna go to the library?
What can we guess about Anna?
options: She does not have a dog.
She lives across from the bakery.

questions.text: What can we guess about the bakery?
options: It sells food that people eat.

vocabulary.definition: a large public area with grass and trees where people can walk and relax
a large area of water surrounded by land
a place where people can borrow and read books
a shop that sells bread, cakes and other baked food

paragraph_translations: Anna mora em uma cidade pequena. Há um parque grande perto da casa dela. No parque há um lago e muitas árvores. Anna gosta de passear lá com o cachorro dela.
Ao lado do parque há uma biblioteca. Anna vai à biblioteca toda segunda-feira. Ela lê livros e faz o dever de casa lá. A padaria fica do outro lado da rua, e vende pão bom.
